{{Quote|And Mandalorians have a purpose. Why bother becoming a Jedi when the Republic only wants you to protect its ''wealth?''<s></s>|Jaska|<ref name="KotOR: War 5">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 5|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''Jaska''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who eschewed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] teachings for [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] culture during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Believing that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was corrupt, she became a member of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dorjander Kace]]'s [[Mandalorian Knights]], a rogue faction of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that sought to help the Mandalorians win the war and become better rulers of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] with the guidance of the Jedi. Joining the [[Revanchist]] movement, an organization of Jedi who aided the Republic war effort, Jaska and the Mandalorian Knights participated in a [[Essien landing|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essien]] in [[3962 BBY]]. During the engagement, she and her fellow Knights were able to use deception to lead the [[Phaeda Militia]], the unit under their command, into Mandalorian captivity and seize the Republic [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], the [[Axehead frigate]] ''[[Reciprocity]]''.

After [[Battle of Halthor|successful]] [[Skirmish on Phaedacomm|attacks]] on the planet [[Halthor]] and the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Phaedacomm]], Jaska followed Kace in the final step of his campaign&mdash;the capture of [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainees]] on the planet [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]], with the purpose of converting them into future Mandalorian Knights. Jaska and the Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] [[Raid on Dantooine|attacked]] the [[Jedi Enclave]] on Dantooine. However, Kace's plans were foiled by the Phaeda [[Militia/Legends|Militia]], and particularly by former Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zayne Carrick]]. Jaska and the Mandalorian Knights were [[Prisoner/Legends|captured]] and faced [[Trial of Dorjander Kace|public trial]] for their [[Treason/Legends|treason]] against the Republic.

==Biography==
===A new purpose===
{{Quote|Onward my friends! The Mandalorian bastion is just beneath Mount Savage! Take the island&mdash;and turn the tide!|Dorjander Kace, to Jaska and the Mandalorian Knights on Essien|<ref name="KotOR: War 1" />}}
Jaska was a [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After passing the [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]] and becoming a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], she served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Republic during the [[Mandalorian Wars]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the Republic and the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]]. By [[3962 BBY]], Jaska had become disillusioned with the Republic, however, believing it to be overly corrupt. Coincidentally, she was not the only Jedi to have come to such a conclusion during that period of [[Time/Legends|time]]. Former [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]] member, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dorjander Kace]]&mdash;who had spent much time in [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Prisoner/Legends|captivity]] during the recent [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]]&mdash;had come to believe that, sooner or later, the Republic would inevitably lose the Mandalorian Wars. However, Kace, having embraced Mandalorian culture during his time as a captive, thought that the Mandalorian rule over the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] would be a better alternative for the Republic, provided the Jedi Order was there to guide the victors. Jaska and several other Jedi were approached by Kace and accepted his teachings, forming the clandestine [[Mandalorian Knights]] group. Never officially leaving the ranks of the Jedi Order, Jaska and the Mandalorian Knights pledged their allegiance to [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], the leader of the Neo-Crusaders,<ref name="KotOR: War 3">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 3|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 3]]</ref> who, in turn, provided the turncoat Jedi with a detachment of Mandalorian [[Troop/Legends|troops]] who were strictly instructed to follow Kace's commands.<ref name="KotOR: War 5" />

[[File:Hammerhead_frigate_KOTOR_W.png|thumb|left|250px|Jaska follows Kace in a speeder bike attack on Essien.]]
To bring about his dream of a Jedi Order&ndash;supported Mandalorian rule of the galaxy sooner, Kace then developed a plan to kidnap [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Younglings]] from the [[Jedi Enclave]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. He planned to raise them in Mandalorian traditions inside a prospective training center on the planet [[Ordo/Legends|Ordo]], thus expanding the ranks of the Mandalorian Knights. Jaska, Kace, and the rest of Kace's disciples then volunteered to join the [[Revanchist]]s, a faction of Jedi who fought on behalf of the Galactic Republic in the war.<ref name="KotOR: War 3" /> The Mandalorian Knights were dispatched to the planet [[Essien]], alongside a Republic military unit called the [[Phaeda Militia]], consisting of natives of the planet [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]] and commanded by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dallan Morvis]]. Once there, Jaska took a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] and followed Kace in an [[Ground warfare/Legends|attack]] on the Mandalorian defenses along the beach line of an [[Unidentified island (Essien)|island]], on top of which was located a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] called [[Mount Savage]]. The mountain served as the location of the [[Mandalorian bastion]].<ref name="KotOR: War 1" />

When Jaska and the Mandalorian Knights returned to Morvis's position, Kace claimed that the Mandalorians had retreated into the [[Tree/Legends|forests]] surrounding Mount Savage. He asked Morvis to help his Knights root out the enemy from the forest, a task which Morvis planned to accomplish by burning the forest with a substance known as [[Tibanna-six]]. Kace specifically asked the Captain to bring every man from his [[Command ship/Legends|command ship]], the [[Axehead frigate]] ''[[Reciprocity]]'', claiming that there were prize [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] to claim at the Mandalorian [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]]. Jaska and the Mandalorian Knights then left Morvis and rendezvoused with the Mandalorian forces. With the ''Reciprocity'' left without guard, the Mandalorians secured it. They then ambushed the Phaeda [[Militia/Legends|Militia]] while Morvis's men were trekking through the forest. Kace's followers and Mandalorian [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] surrounded Morvis and his troops and forcibly conscripted them to join their cause.<ref name="KotOR: War 1" />

===Abducting the children===
{{Quote|Not so fast, Younglings!|Jaska, as she uses the Force to stop a pair of Jedi children from escaping|<ref name="KotOR: War 5" />}}
Kace next employed the Phaeda Militia in a successful [[Battle of Halthor|conquest]] of a [[Halthor signal station|signal station]] on the planet [[Halthor]]. Jaska was present at a motivating speech that Kace gave to the Mandalorian warriors after the battle,<ref name="KotOR: War 2">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 2|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 2]]</ref> and then embarked on another mission alongside Kace and the Mandalorian Knights. In his effort to sever all communications between Dantooine and the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]], Kace had originally targeted Phaeda itself. However, [[Zayne Carrick]], a former Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] and a member of the Phaeda Militia, was hoping to save his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]. Therefore, he proposed a plan to infiltrate [[Phaedacomm]], a [[Bith/Legends|Bith]]-operated [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located within the [[Phaeda system/Legends|Phaeda system]]. Phaedacomm handled all signal traffic for Phaeda and connected the planet to the rest of the galaxy; therefore, holding the station for a few [[Standard day/Legends|days]] would satisfy Kace's plan. Following Carrick's idea, the Mandalorian Knights and warriors took the ''Reciprocity'' to Phaeda. On the approach to the planet, they were intercepted by the [[Phaeda Planetary Defense Force]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Derapha (cruiser)|''Derapha'']]. The ''Derapha'' refused to let the ''Reciprocity'' approach Phaeda without speaking to Captain Morvis, since they had received no word from him since the battle on Essien. However, Carrick answered to the cruiser's hails and lied that he was the only crew member left standing, after Morvis and the rest of the militia had been exposed to an unknown [[Bioweapon/Legends|bioweapon]] used by the Mandalorians on Essien and were currently in [[Medical bay/Legends|sick bay]]. Kace stated that his Jedi were unaffected but that Carrick required immediate medical help. The crew of the ''Derapha'' were hesitant to let the ''Reciprocity'' land on Phaeda and potentially spread the unknown disease there, so the cruiser instead directed the Republic ship to Phaedacomm, which possessed a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical station]] with a quarantine area.<ref name="KotOR: War 3" />

[[File:Attack_on_Phaedacomm.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jaska fighting on Phaedacomm]]
After docking with Phaedacomm, Jaska and the Knights delivered Carrick and the Mandalorian strike team inside the medical facility, using sealed biohazard-containment bags and lying to the Bith station operators that the bags carried the infected members of the Phaeda militia. Before the bags could be delivered inside the quarantine area, Carrick, who was wearing makeup applied to make him look infected, broke out of his bag and started calling for help. By doing so, Carrick had hoped to leave the Bith with no choice but to quarantine the entire station or risk the disease breaking out. However, the Bith wanted to evacuate from the facility instead. Kace tried to use a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to convince them to stay, but at that point, the Mandalorians emerged from the containment bags, tired of waiting and acting covertly. The crusaders [[Skirmish on Phaedacomm|attacked]] the Bith, so Jaska and the Mandalorian Knights were forced to join the fight as well. The Bith were quickly [[Death/Legends|killed]], and Kace established his control of Phaedacomm.<ref name="KotOR: War 3" />

Shortly afterward, the former Jedi Master rallied Jaska and the rest of his Knights aboard the ''Reciprocity'' for the final attack on Dantooine. The Mandalorian Knights and an advance force of Neo-Crusaders used the Republic vessel to reach Dantooine, while a trio of [[Kandosii-type dreadnaught|''Kandosii''-type dreadnaughts]] provided by [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] were supposed to arrive later. When hailed by the Dantooine Enclave, Kace claimed that the ''Reciprocity'' had been dispatched by the Republic to reinforce the Jedi Enclave's security until the communications problem was fixed. The bluff worked, and Jaska and the Mandalorian Knights were allowed to land on Dantooine.<ref name="KotOR: War 4">[[Knights of the Old Republic: War 4|''Knights of the Old Republic: War'' 4]]</ref> Once there, Kace's forces [[Raid on Dantooine|rounded up]] the Enclave's staff and [[Jedi training/Legends|trainees]]. Jaska herself spotted and captured a pair of [[Youngling/Legends|Younglings]] who were trying to slip away unnoticed during the hassle. The invaders then locked Jedi Master [[Zhar Lestin]] and the rest of the staff inside the [[Dantooine Jedi Enclave Council|local Jedi Council's]] convocation chamber. Meanwhile, Kace explained to the Younglings that they were going to be joining the Mandalorians. At that moment, a [[Shaadlar-type troopship|''Shaadlar''-type troopship]] landed near the Enclave to bring the trainees to the [[Dreadnaught/Legends|dreadnaught]] waiting above the surface of the planet. Kace, Jaska, and the Mandalorians escorted the Jedi children to the troopship, where they met a squad of Mandalorians led by a [[Field Marshal/Legends|Field Marshal]], who introduced himself as [[Glomkettle Hierogryph|Glomkettle]], the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the dreadnaught ''[[Parjai]]'' in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="KotOR: War 5" />

The Field Marshal claimed that the other two dreadnaughts had been delayed and assured Kace that the ''Parjai'' was ready to take aboard all of the Younglings. However, Kace quickly deduced that Glomkettle and his men were, in fact, Carrick and the members of Phaeda militia in disguise. Kace exposed them and ordered Jaska and the others to cut them off from their troopship. However, Carrick created a distraction by activating the troopship's [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]]. A firefight broke out, in the midst of which the Phaeda militia evacuated the children aboard the ''Reciprocity''. Kace and Carrick clashed in a fight that culminated with a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] inside the Jedi Enclave. Meanwhile, the Mandalorian forces on Dantooine received news that Mandalore had broken the deal he had with Kace&mdash;providing him with soldiers in return for future Mandalorian Knights raised on Ordo&mdash;and recalled the two remaining dreadnaughts following Carrick's capture of the ''Parjai''. Already viewing Kace's motives of capturing children as not fitting the Mandalorian [[Canons of Honor|code of honor]], the Neo-Crusaders started to leave the planet. Eventually, Kace stood down as well, and Jaska and the rest of the Mandalorian Knights were taken into custody and faced [[Trial of Dorjander Kace|public trial]] on the galactic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="KotOR: War 5" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|We are rounding the Padawans up in the courtyard, Master Kace! We have them all!''"<br />"''Fine, ''Jaska''&mdash;but for the thousandth time, call me ''Dorjander''. Among the Mandalorians, we're all equal!|Jaska, reporting to Kace on Dantooine|<ref name="KotOR: War 5" />}}
Jaska had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]], styled in a dreadlocked ponytail. By the height of the Mandalorian Wars, Jaska started to believe that the Galactic Republic had become too corrupt<ref name="KotOR: War 3" /> and that being a Jedi ultimately equaled merely protecting the Republic's wealth, something she did not agree with. Therefore, she readily accepted Dorjander Kace's offer to join the ranks of the Mandalorian Knights. Alongside other Knights, she believed that they had been wasting their lives on small tasks for the Order until Kace gave them purpose. Jaska held high respect for her mentor, calling him "Master Kace," even though he asked her countless times to call him by his first name, trying to teach Jaska that they were all equal among the Mandalorians.<ref name="KotOR: War 5" />

==Powers and abilities==
Trained as a Jedi Knight, Jaska was skilled at [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|using]] her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in battle, which she demonstrated while fighting on Phaedacomm and Dantooine. As a Mandalorian Knight, Jaska wore a suit of [[Color/Legends|gray]] Mandalorian armor, donned with green markings and equipped with a jetpack, and wielded the same bronze-colored lightsaber as the other members of Kace's faction. On Dantooine, Jaska also demonstrated her [[Force-sensitive/Legends|affinity]] with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], using [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] to stop two Younglings from escaping the Mandalorian attack.<ref name="KotOR: War 5" /> Additionally, Jaska was able to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] a speeder bike.<ref name="KotOR: War 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaska was created as a minor character in the [[2012]] five-issue [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: War]]''. Initially unnamed,<ref name="KotOR: War 1" /> Jaska was identified by her name only in the [[Knights of the Old Republic: War 5|final issue]] of the story arc.<ref name="KotOR: War 5" /> Published from [[January 11]]th<ref name="KotOR: War 1" /> to [[May 9]]th, the series was written by [[John Jackson Miller]] and penciled by [[Andrea Mutti]].<ref name="KotOR: War 5" />
